note: Since M26 these are quick settings, not laws: taxes by estate (set in the Treasury), the court (Treasury) and monster bounties (Military), each resting settingDays between changes. The laws proper are in data/book.json. Laws and their options. Changing a law needs Authority at least its love value and spends that much of the folk's Love, at most what there is (M24 B), and crowns, then phases in over enactDays. Effects are fractions (0.2 = +20%) or points; unrest and prosperity may be scoped by settlement type. Opinion values shift each group's settled view of the crown while the law stands.

light.blurb: Lower the head tax and the market dues: the burghers keep more and the towns grow richer.

fair.blurb: What the towns have always paid.

light.blurb: The lords pay a token due. They like the crown for it.

fair.name: Fair
fair.blurb: Each great house pays its customary due by the size of its lands.

heavy.name: Heavy

frugal.name: A frugal court
frugal.blurb: Plain food, few feasts, fewer courtiers.

splendid.name: A splendid court
splendid.blurb: Tourneys, masques and favours. The lords come to Vizima and stay.

none.name: No bounties
none.blurb: Villages deal with their own drowners.

witchers.name: Witcher contracts
witchers.blurb: Royal coin for mutants who kill monsters. The priests of the Fire mutter.
